read.en: ASML rose 2.8% on Oct 21 to $1,676.69, trading between $1,661.62 and $1,687.81. It is above the falling 5-day ($1,650.7) and rising 200-day ($1,584.7) averages, but below the falling 10-day ($1,692.2) and 30-day ($1,721.6) and the rising 100-day ($1,750.1). MACD has been below its signal since Oct 12 and is below zero, with the histogram narrowing; Parabolic SAR has been bearish since Oct 13 ($1,802.34), and RSI is 44.

The close cleared the $1,650–1,654 resistance (5-day, Oct 20 high), now support, but the high stalled at $1,688 (Oct 13 low, Oct 16 high). Resistance is $1,684–1,692 (with the 10-day), then $1,722 (30-day) and $1,750 (100-day). Support is $1,650, then $1,613–1,619 and $1,594 (Oct 15 low). A close above $1,692 would target $1,722–1,750; a close below $1,613 would reopen $1,594.
